title: B8 agent output (b8-faulty-fixer)
description: Section 10/B8 'Agent output' line and the b8-faulty-fixer agent file (Appendix B), including its worked examples. Minor note: the agent file's 'Allowed values' adds 'unsure' to issue_reason beyond Section 10/B8's and config/allowed_values.yaml's matching 6-value lists -- read as Rule 6 ('unsure is always allowed') rather than a true conflict, so it is included here.

notice_says.description: What the exam body's notice states, if anything; empty string if there is no notice or it says nothing relevant.

text.description: Copied exactly from one of the latest_passages given.

supporting_quote.description: Must be verified word for word in the latest edition when present; null when no supporting passage applies (e.g. issue_reason error_in_question with no NCERT angle).

corrected_stem.description: Only set when choosing an answer cannot fix the question; change as little as possible.

corrected_options.description: Keyed by option number ('1'-'4') for only the option(s) changed; null when not needed.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
